target_component: The Little Utopia / Mauritius QPE & Confirmed Floor
description: CineGlobe engine qualifies $301,131 undeployed contingency reserve as confirmed QPE. EDB Film Rebate Scheme requires audited qualifying expenditure incurred and paid in Mauritius; unspent reserves are statutorily non-qualifying.
controlling_rule: Economic Development Board (Film Rebate Scheme Regulations 2018 First Schedule §3)
resolution_summary: Exclude undeployed contingency from confirmed QPE. Confirmed floor incentive must be reduced by $90,339.30 (from $1,306,598.10 to $1,216,258.80 before travel normalization, or $1,093,209.30 at supported QPE).

target_component: F#K Valentine's Day / Greece QPE & Cash Rebate
description: CineGlobe engine improperly substitutes Greece statutory 80% ceiling cap ($3,614,149.60 = 80.00% of $4,517,687) as actual qualifying spend. Engine qualified foreign ATL cast ($1,246,288), producers, story rights, travel, exceeding the cap and clamping to 80%. A statutory ceiling is an upper bound, never a valid substitute for actual territorial spend.
controlling_rule: Hellenic Republic Law 4487/2017 Art. 26 para. 2; JMD 607434 / JMD 140524
resolution_summary: Engine must derive actual Greek territorial expenditure from line items ($1,297,010.00) and only apply min(actual_spend, 0.80 * total_budget). CineGlobe overstated Greek QPE by $2,317,139.60 and rebate by $926,855.84.

target_component: Lips Like Sugar / California Program Rate & QPE Base
description: CineGlobe engine qualifies $3,174,975 of Above-The-Line spend and $400,000 residuals reserve in QPE, and applies a 35% base rate from future Program 4.0 legislation (effective 2025+) to a 2023-2024 production that applied for, was budgeted under, and received binding CFC reservation under Program 3.0 (25% independent BTL rate).
controlling_rule: Cal. Rev. & Tax Code § 17053.98; CFC Program 3.0 Guidelines; CFC Credit Allocation Letter CAL #8-053
assigned_owner: Program Rate Rules & Spend Treatment Engine
resolution_summary: Exclude all ATL lines and residuals reserve from California QPE ($3,871,358 reduction). Apply Program 3.0 25% BTL rate for 2023/2024 applications unless post-2025 Program 4.0 election is affirmatively documented. Engine overstated incentive by $1,988,913.90 vs CFC binding reservation.

target_component: F#K Valentine's Day QPE Provenance Statement
description: Prior AG audit report falsely stated that FVD served QPE ($3,614,149.60) equaled gross ($4,517,687) minus contingency ($362,866) minus finance fee ($453,583). That arithmetic ($3,701,238) was incorrect. The actual mathematical source is exactly 80.00% of gross budget ($4,517,687 * 0.80) via QPE_CAP_RULES['gr_cash_rebate'].
controlling_rule: Mandatory Audit Integrity Correction § FVD Provenance
resolution_summary: False statement formally retracted and corrected. 80.00% statutory ceiling cap substitution identified and documented.
